products.title: Fruity Puppy Original
products.description: 45% real fresh Hawaiian tropical fruit. Ice-extracted, suspended in a crystalline lipid matrix. 17 bioavailable antioxidants. 2 oz.

products.title: FPX
products.description: Extra-strength exfoliating fruit cream. Fruity Puppy Original with more papaya and added starfruit. 2 oz. Not for sensitive skin.

products.title: Lava-Guava Bomb Balm
products.description: High-friction + high-moisture zones. Guava leaf, stickerbush shoots, and ti leaf. Coming into the line.

products.title: Thorny Toad Face Juice
products.description: Botanical toner for balance and clarity. Stickerbush cane, green tea, guava leaf, lemon peel, jungle mint.

products.title: Desert Squirt
products.description: A dry-climate botanical ritual. Returning to the fridge line.

products.title: Moon Tea
products.description: Nocturnal botanical polishing toner. Blackberry leaf, orange peel, green tea, spearmint, cranberry hibiscus shoots.

products.description: Try Fruity Puppy Original. $5 shipping & handling.
